title: Finite locally constant set sheaves are finite sheaves
statement: Let Y be a scheme and F a sheaf of types on the small etale site of Y. If an etale cover trivializes F on each member as a constant sheaf with a finite type value, then IsFiniteSheaf F.

source.place: Definition 03RU (4), Lemma 03Q1 (3), and Remark 03P5; finite-stalk consequence formulated for the Lean IsFiniteSheaf predicate

proof.text: Lift every geometric point to a member of the etale cover. Reindex pointed etale neighbourhoods along the fibre product to obtain a surjection from the restricted stalk onto the original stalk. Transport across the local isomorphism and use that the stalk of a constant sheaf is a quotient of its finite constant value. This gives a finitely generated (indeed finite) stalk at every geometric point, hence IsFiniteSheaf.
